text.text_excerpt: A FAVORITE CBD LUNCH COUNTER*** 1. Outstanding BBQ: the ribs are thick, brisket and pork are juicy; (chicken is pulled, but you can opt for a breast). 2. Best sauces in town, nothing sexy or cutesy. There are basically two: the smokey "Traditional" with an amped spicier "Bold" version (the best!); and the "Sweet" that also comes in a stronger "Heavy" option. 3. The sides are the weakest part of the meal. My favorites are the not-too-mayonnaisey slaw and the steamed corn, but the muffins taste like packing tape. YOU CAN'T BEAT THE PRICE OR PRACTICALITY 1. I was attending a conference at the Hyatt Hotel and was looking for a lunch option that wouldn't break the bank. I was happy to see signs directing me to this place! It is quite difficult to find, however, if you are coming from the Hyatt, because it is actually in the Entergy building, and the handy directional signs disappear at some point (at a fork in the road of all places). If you are fortunate enough to find it on the ground floor of the Entergy building near the main entrance, then you are going to find some surprisingly good Q. Solid BBQ, super friendly staff, large portions and good prices make Q a great lunch spot. I had the BBQ salad added shredded cheese with brisket on the side. The salad was super fresh, every ingredient from the chopped green onions to the corn sliced right off the cob was fresh and delicious. The brisket was moist and had the right amount of smoke with a variety of help your self sauces ranging from Bold to heavy molasses sweet are on each table ready for you to create just the right mix. This is definitely a spot I'll frequent as they have everything from breakfast to daily specials in addition to the traditional BBQ plates that feature sides of mac and cheese to greens.
